hud: the HUD always shows the TRUE distance; the loupe only enlarges the image angularly by M
why: The headset can show at most ~12.5 cycles/deg, the zebra resolves 23.3. Without the loupe, detail the zebra can see would be lost on the display. The loupe magnifies the zebra's view by M so the finest zebra-resolvable stripes fit the headset's pixels.
